Zoe T.: hey team — quick onboarding question. I'm scheduled for the weekend rotation but I'm in EMEA and the timezone makes the Tue handoff awkward. Can I swap with someone and still get my two shadow sessions in? :wave:

Michael O.: welcome Zoe! You can swap with anyone on the week prior, just follow the swap flow: create a swap request in PagerDuty and post the swap id here. We require 2x shadows within your first 2 rotations; swapping is fine as long as you complete them before your first solo.

Zoe T.: thanks — swap id PD-SWAP-772 posted. Also I still don't have edit/comment access to a couple of runbooks for services we'll handle. I can only view. Who to ping?

Priya S.: hey Zoe — I can shadow you for one of the slots. For runbooks, submit the oncall-runbooks access request (https://wiki.internal/access-requests) and paste the PRR id. We keep edit rights locked until after 2 shadows + 1 supervised solo but comment access is granted earlier. If you need to propose edits for clarity, open a PR and tag runbook-owners.

RunbooksBot: Access request required: runbook repo write access is restricted. Suggested flow: PRR-<number> via wiki form. Automated reviewer will add owner tags.

Zoe T.: submitted PRR-5899 for comment access. Swap PD-SWAP-772 is pending acceptance. Priya — I'm available Fri 09:00-10:30 UTC for a shadow, or Sun 16:00-17:30 UTC if that fits your schedule.

Michael O.: PD swap accepted by @devops-team. You're now scheduled for the weekend rotation and marked as backup for Tue. Priya — if you can do Fri that's ideal so Zoe has one shadow before weekend.

Priya S.: Fri 09:00-10:30 UTC works. Zoe — run the PD delivery test after you get added: ```pd trigger --user "zoe.t@redwood.com" --note "oncall test"``` Confirm mobile + email. Also practice a sim in #eng-oncall-sim: `sre-sim start --user zoet`

RunbooksBot: Access grant: user "Zoe T." added to group "oncall-runbooks" (read/comment) by Priya S. (audit id: d8f4).

PagerDutyBot: PD test reminder sent to "zoe.t@redwood.com". If no response in 60s, escalate to Michael O.

Zoe T.: got the PD push and the runbook comment access. Thanks everyone — I accepted the Fri slot and will run the sim tonight. One thing: can I submit a PR for a small clarification now or do I wait until after probation?

Priya S.: submit the PR now. We'll request owner + SRE reviewer; small clarifications merge fast. No direct pushes to main. If it affects triage, mark it high priority.

Zoe T.: perfect, PR opened and tagged owners. Appreciate the quick help! :rocket:
